calls.query: SELECT s.store_id, s.name, c.customer_id, c.account_number FROM stores s LEFT JOIN customers c ON c.store_id=s.store_id WHERE s.name ILIKE '%rural%cycle%'

SELECT l.sku, sum(l.order_qty::numeric) q, count(*) FROM sales_orders o JOIN sales_order_lines l ON l.sales_order_id=o.sales_order_id WHERE (o.customer_id::text IN ('10','29770') OR o.account_number IN ('AW00000010','AW00029770')) AND o.order_date::date >= '2024-07-01' GROUP BY l.sku ORDER BY q DESC LIMIT 15

SELECT o.sales_order_id, o.order_date, o.status, o.customer_id, o.account_number, count(*) n FROM sales_orders o JOIN sales_order_lines l ON l.sales_order_id=o.sales_order_id WHERE (o.customer_id::text IN ('10','29770') OR o.account_number IN ('AW00000010','AW00029770')) GROUP BY 1,2,3,4,5 ORDER BY 2
SELECT upper(trim(l.sku)) s, sum(l.order_qty::numeric) q FROM sales_order_lines l WHERE l.sales_order_id IN (53527,58972,65206,71841) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY q DESC LIMIT 5
SELECT product_number, name, make_flag, finished_goods_flag FROM products WHERE upper(trim(product_number))='BK-M68B-38'

SELECT 'ip' src, product_number, list_price::text, null::text sd, null::text ed FROM item_prices WHERE upper(trim(product_number))='BK-M68B-38' UNION ALL SELECT 'h', product_number, list_price::text, start_date::text, end_date::text FROM list_price_history WHERE upper(trim(product_number))='BK-M68B-38'

SELECT work_order_id, part_no, order_qty, stocked_qty, scrapped_qty, start_date, end_date FROM work_orders WHERE upper(trim(part_no))='BK-M68B-38' AND end_date >= '2025-04-01' AND end_date < '2025-07-01'

SELECT count(*), sum(order_qty), sum(stocked_qty), sum(scrapped_qty), min(end_date), max(end_date) FROM work_orders WHERE upper(trim(part_no))='BK-M68B-38' AND end_date >= '2025-04-01' AND end_date < '2025-07-01'

WITH RECURSIVE t AS (SELECT component_number c, 1 lvl FROM bom WHERE upper(trim(assembly_number))='BK-M68B-38' AND (end_date IS NULL) UNION SELECT b.component_number, t.lvl+1 FROM bom b JOIN t ON b.assembly_number=t.c WHERE b.end_date IS NULL) SELECT t.c, t.lvl, p.make_flag FROM t LEFT JOIN products p ON p.product_number=t.c

WITH RECURSIVE t AS (SELECT component_number c, end_date FROM bom WHERE upper(trim(assembly_number))='BK-M68B-38' UNION SELECT b.component_number, b.end_date FROM bom b JOIN t ON b.assembly_number=t.c) SELECT t.c, t.end_date::text, p.make_flag FROM t LEFT JOIN products p ON p.product_number=t.c WHERE t.end_date IS NOT NULL OR p.make_flag IS NULL

question: A customer writes in: "Hi, this is Rural Cycle Emporium. We'd like to reorder the bike we have bought the most units of from you on orders placed since 1 July 2024. Which bike is that, and what is its current list price? How many units can you ship from stock today, across all your locations? How many units of it did your factory finish in the second quarter of 2025 (work orders that ended April to June 2025)? And if you have to build more, what is the longest supplier lead time, in days, among the parts you buy in for it?" Answer in the form 'bike: NAME, list price: $X, in stock: N, built in Q2 2025: N, longest lead time: N days'.
